install: set -euo pipefail; missing=(); for cmd in jq python3; do command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$cmd"); done; if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq "${missing[@]}"; fi; jq empty manifest.json && test -f index.html
